selection.reason: CShells.FastEndpoints 0.0.28 is the stable adapter matching the selected CShells 0.0.28 ABI and pins FastEndpoints 7.2.0 for net10.0.

reviewedBehavior.discovery: CShells discovers endpoints only from explicitly enabled IFastEndpointsShellFeature implementations.
reviewedBehavior.routing: The Program Kit projection emits exact method and route declarations from the accepted OpenAPI operation projection.
reviewedBehavior.authorization: Every projected endpoint calls AllowAnonymous to neutralize FastEndpoints secure-by-default ownership; the existing generated ASP.NET Core operation-authorization middleware remains the sole policy owner.
reviewedBehavior.failures: Every projected endpoint calls DontCatchExceptions so the existing generated ASP.NET Core exception-handler and Problem Details pipeline remains the sole transport-failure owner.
reviewedBehavior.dispatch: A generated provider-neutral dispatcher port receives the exact operation revision and HttpContext; consumer code owns request, response, and operation behavior.
reviewedBehavior.openApi: The accepted Program Kit OpenAPI projection remains authoritative; FastEndpoints does not generate a parallel document.
reviewedBehavior.sourceGate: The strong-named FastEndpoints 7.2.0.0 EndpointWithoutRequest contract is admitted only for internal sealed Program Kit-owned sources directly below ProgramKitGenerated/Hosting that implement the exact IEndpoint contract and declare only Configure and HandleAsync overrides.

boundaries.rolesClaimsPermissionsScopes: not inferred or generated by this adapter
boundaries.operationSemantics: consumer-owned through the generated dispatcher port
boundaries.automaticDiscovery: limited to explicitly selected shell feature assemblies
boundaries.sourceGateAccommodation: exact assembly identity, ownership header, logical path, accessibility, inheritance, and public override surface fail closed
